blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) has several core concepts that make programs organized, reusable, and easier to manage. These concepts include classes and objects, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: A class is like a blueprint, while an object is the real thing created from that blueprint.
